title: 第五章 老祖宗归来第六章 倾力栽培
lines: 二月初九，东宁城外一处荒野，天色阴沉。
“呦。”一道悠扬的鸟鸣声响起，只见一头沐浴在雷霆中的巨大飞禽从云端俯冲而下，飞禽背上却是盘膝坐着两道身影。
这飞禽接近地面时，庞大双翼上有雷霆朝四面八方冲击开去，令整个荒野地面都一震，电蛇四散游走，随即才消散。
这时，两道身影才从飞禽背上落下。
一位是中年妇人，另一位则是拄着拐杖的老妇人。
“黄师妹，我已经到了，到我家乡了，你回去吧。”拄着拐杖的老妇人笑道。
“孟姐姐。”中年妇人眼中隐隐有着些许泪花，她的‘孟姐姐’之前还没这么苍老，这次重伤，老态尽显，可看容貌依旧能依稀看出，老妇人年轻时也是美人。
“此次一别，我们怕是再难相见。”老妇人慨叹笑道，“不过我算好得了，至少死前能回到家乡，在家乡度过这辈子最后的几年。那些战死的，可真的成了黄土一堆了。”
“孟姐姐，你若是有什么需要我帮忙的，书信一封即可，我黄香凝定当尽心竭力。”中年妇人郑重说道。
“要求到你的，我会开口的。”老妇人笑着，“好了，赶紧回去吧。”
中年妇人仔细看着老妇人，最后还是一跃上了飞禽背上，很快飞禽一震双翼，雷霆在虚空中弥漫四方。
呼。
携带着雷霆闪电，飞禽迅速一飞冲天，消失在天边。
老妇人看着同伴离去，这才转头看向东宁城，面带笑意：“该回家了，能落叶归根，老天待我不薄！”
老妇人手中的拐杖，轻轻一敲击地面，敲击处有虚空波纹荡起，一阵阵弥漫四方，笼罩周围百丈范围。
她持着拐杖，被波纹笼罩着，也朝东宁城走去，每一步都是数十丈。即便从官道上的一些行人商队旁走过，那些人们却仿佛没看见‘老妇人’，依旧笑呵呵聊着。
片刻，她来到了城门入口。
“东宁城。”
老妇人拄着拐杖，看着面前这座雄伟的城池。
这是她的家乡！年少时生活的地方。
老妇人微笑着继续迈步前进，城门口大量人们包括门口的守卫，都没看到老妇人。老妇人就仿佛不存在这个世界上，就这么进了城，行走在街道上，又来到了孟家的祖宅。
进入祖宅。
祖宅巡逻的族人很多，可同样都看不见老妇人。
“咕咕咕。”在祖宅的其中一座小院内，胖老者正在喝着闷酒。
“平平，你在偷喝酒？”一道声音在小院内响起。
胖老者吓得一个激灵，连看向周围，忍不住道：“三姐，是你吗？三姐？”
在院子中凭空显现出了一名拄着拐杖的老妇人，正笑看着他。
“三姐。”
胖老者眼睛都红了，他是‘孟仙姑’唯一的亲弟弟。虽说家族内其他长老们也有喊‘三姐’的，那是因为家族太过庞大，毕竟有上千年历史的家族，许多家族子弟都隔了好几层了。胖老者名叫‘孟炎平’，孟家当代族长，他比孟仙姑小了近二十岁，所以小时候也是孟仙姑带着他，又是当姐姐又是当娘。
在他心中，他三姐一直那么年轻，那么美丽，那么无所不能，如今却老了这么多。
“哭什么哭，我不是活的好好的？”老妇人笑道。
“三姐，你的伤真的没法医治？”胖老者追问道。
“只要不拼命厮杀，还是能活七八年的。”老妇人淡然道，“人有生老病死，神魔同样有寿命极限，有什么好伤心的。接下来几年时间足以我妥善安置我孟家，我重伤的消息传回，东宁府可有什么动静？”
“云家和我孟家解除了婚约，就是孟川小家伙的婚约。”胖老者说道，“至于其他，四大神魔家族也只是做些小动作，根本不敢真的惹怒我孟家。”
“嗯，当初定下婚约，云万海也是想要借我孟家的势。如今我重伤，他解除小辈的婚约也正常。”
content_en:
On the ninth day of February, in a wilderness outside Dongning City, the sky was gloomy.
"Yo." A melodious bird song sounded, and a huge bird bathed in thunder swooped down from the clouds. On the back of the bird were two figures sitting cross-legged.
"Boom!"
When the bird approached the ground, thunder struck from its huge wings in all directions, shaking the entire wilderness ground. The electric snakes scattered in all directions before dissipating.
At this time, two figures fell from the back of the bird.
One is a middle-aged woman and the other is an old woman on crutches.
"Junior sister Huang, I'm already here. I'm in my hometown. You can go back." The old woman on crutches said with a smile.
"Sister Meng." There were some tears in the middle-aged woman's eyes. Her 'Sister Meng' had not been so old before. This time she was seriously injured and her age was fully visible. However, her appearance could still vaguely tell that the old woman was also beautiful when she was young.
"After this farewell, I'm afraid we will never see each other again." The old woman sighed and smiled, "But it's better for me. At least I can return to my hometown before I die and spend the last few years of my life there. Those who died in the war have really become a pile of loess."
"Sister Meng, if you need my help in any way, just write a letter. I, Huang Xiangning, will do my best." The middle-aged woman said solemnly.
"I will ask you what I want." The old woman smiled, "Okay, go back quickly."
The middle-aged woman looked at the old woman carefully, and finally jumped on the back of the bird. Soon the bird flapped its wings, and thunder filled the air in all directions.
call.
Carrying thunder and lightning, the bird quickly flew into the sky and disappeared from the horizon.
The old woman watched her companion leave, then turned to look at Dongning City with a smile on her face: "It's time to go home. I can return my fallen leaves to my roots. God has been kind to me!"
"Boom."
The crutch in the old woman's hand tapped the ground gently, and ripples of void rippled out where she struck, spreading in all directions and covering the surrounding area of a hundred feet.
She was holding a crutch, shrouded in ripples, and walked towards Dongning City, each step measuring dozens of feet. Even when passing by some pedestrian caravans on the official road, those people seemed not to see the 'old woman' and were still laughing and chatting.
After a while, she arrived at the city gate entrance.
"Dongning City."
The old woman leaned on a cane and looked at the majestic city in front of her.
This is her hometown! The place where I lived when I was young.
The old woman smiled and continued to move forward. A large number of people at the city gate, including the guards at the gate, did not see the old woman. As if the old woman did not exist in this world, she just entered the city, walked on the streets, and came to the ancestral home of the Meng family.
Enter the ancestral home.
There were many clan members patrolling the ancestral home, but they could not see the old woman either.
"Cuckoo." In one of the small courtyards of the ancestral home, a fat old man was drinking wine.
"Pingping, are you drinking secretly?" A voice sounded in the small courtyard.
The fat old man was so frightened that he looked around and couldn't help but said: "Third sister, is that you? Third sister?"
An old woman on crutches appeared out of thin air in the yard, looking at him with a smile.
"Third sister."
The fat old man's eyes were red. He was the only biological brother of 'Meng Xiangu'. Although other elders in the family also call them "Third Sister", that's because the family is too big. After all, in a family with a history of thousands of years, many of the family's children are separated by several levels. The fat old man's name is 'Meng Yanping', the current patriarch of the Meng family. He is nearly twenty years younger than Meng Xiangu, so Meng Xiangu took care of him when he was a child, acting as both his elder sister and mother.
In his heart, his third sister had always been so young, so beautiful, so omnipotent, but now she was so much older.
"Why are you crying? Am I not alive and well?" the old woman said with a smile.
"Third Sister, is your injury really incurable?" the fat old man asked.
"As long as you don't fight desperately, you can still live for seven or eight years." The old woman said calmly, "Human beings are born, old, sick, and die, and gods and demons also have life spans. There is nothing to be sad about. The next few years will be enough for me to properly arrange the Meng family. When the news of my serious injury comes back, is there any news in Dongning Mansion?"
"The Yun family and my Meng family have terminated their engagement, which is the engagement of little Meng Chuan." The fat old man said, "As for the rest, the four major gods and demon families only made small moves and did not dare to really anger my Meng family."
"Well, when we made the engagement, Yun Wanhai also wanted to take advantage of my Meng family's influence. Now that I'm seriously injured, it's normal for him to terminate the engagement of my junior."
